verdict.rationale: E2B's SDK documents reading files with `files.read()` and writing single or multiple files with `files.write()`, plus listing directories with `files.list()`. This covers the read/write core of the story. Dedicated upload and download flows (local-to-sandbox and sandbox-to-local) are not explicitly documented in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit upload/download documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of filesystem SDK usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read, write, upload, and download files in the sandbox filesystem via the SDK

citations.quote: You can read files from the sandbox filesystem using the `files.read()` method.
You can write single files to the sandbox filesystem using the `files.write()` method.
You can also write multiple files to the sandbox.
